calibration_notes: No real accepted/negative identity photo pairs were available at calibration time, so this was calibrated against synthetic same-identity (slightly perturbed frame/lighting of the same reference) and different-identity (distinct synthetic reference) image pairs: same-identity pairs scored ~0.994, different-identity pairs scored ~0.65-0.78. 0.85 is a midpoint guard with margin on both sides. Recalibrate against real accepted_v1/negative_v1 identity photo pairs once available - same open item Arslan's voice_threshold_v1.json flagged for its own fixture set.
implementation: mean-centered cosine similarity (Pearson correlation) on a 32x32 RGB pixel grid, comparing the identity reference image against a representative extracted frame from the generated avatar video; no model download required
